dict.Marfa dată înapoi furnizorilor (neconfor: Goods sent back to suppliers (nonconforming, damaged, over-delivered or wrong): the value with VAT, the reason, the supplier's answer and the credit note received; you get the amount still to recover and the status: recovered (green), partly recovered or awaiting the credit note (yellow), refused or unresolved for more than 30 days (red).
dict.Marfa returnată pleacă cu aviz de însoți: Returned goods leave with a delivery note or a return invoice; the supplier then sends the credit note (the negative invoice), entered here with its number and amount.
dict.Neconformitățile se anunță prin Docs → N: Nonconformities are reported with Docs → Delivery nonconformity notice; the quantities received are in Sheets → Goods receipt note.
dict.Retururile refuzate și cele nerezolvate: Refused returns and those unresolved for more than 30 days count in Sheets → Supplier evaluation.
dict.Proces-verbal de retur al mărfii către f: Report on goods returned to the supplier
dict.Marfa dată înapoi furnizorului: document: Goods given back to the supplier: the document they came in with, the returned products with quantity, value and reason, who hands them over and who receives them, with the request for the credit note (the negative invoice) within the agreed term
